RESULT — point-in-time consolidated text, two distinct versions of the same article:

version 1: date 2000-01-01 snapshot, 2868 fragments
  Artigo 1601.º (Impedimentos dirimentes absolutos)
  FragmentoVersaoId 58403586, DataEntradaVigor 1978-04-01, DataVersao 1977-11-25
  "...a) A idade inferior a dezasseis anos; b) A demência notória, mesmo durante os
   intervalos lúcidos, e a interdição ou inabilitação..."

version 2: date 2026-06-23 snapshot, 2895 fragments
  Artigo 1601.º (Impedimentos dirimentes absolutos)
  FragmentoVersaoId 1115206175, DataEntradaVigor 2025-04-02, DataVersao 2025-04-01
  "...a) A idade inferior a 18 anos; b) A demência notória, mesmo durante os intervalos
   lúcidos, e a decisão de acompanhamento..."

REFORM TIMELINE for the same diploma (AlteracoesTimelineByDiplomaLegisId):
  102 amending diplomas, 1165 individual modifications
  71 distinct entry-into-force dates, range 1900-01-01 .. 2026-07-01
  1038 distinct target fragment versions
  Each modification carries: TipoModificacao (Altera/Revoga/Aditado/...), target article,
  FragmentoVersaoDestinoId, structural path, DataEntradaVigor, and the amending diploma's
  number, type, summary, publication date and LinkSitemap.

GATE: PASSED — >= 2 distinct versions with dates extracted from one law, plus a complete
per-reform timeline with effective dates and the amending diploma for every change.

PROTOCOL NOTE (the non-obvious bit): DataActionGetData raises
System.NullReferenceException unless the screen variable
"GetDiplomaFragByIdAndApplicationSetting" carries back the full output of the preceding
DataActionGetDiplomaFragByIdAndApplicationSetting call. Block actions
(AlteracoesTimelineByDiplomaLegisId) must be posted with viewName
"LegislacaoConsolidada.LegCons_Detalhe" — posting the block's own name returns
{"exception": "No role validation found"}.
